messages:
Oncall Bot: ALERT: spike in model-serving error_rate across us-west-*/prod -> Paging: pagerduty-incident (service: inference-runtime)
Oncall Bot: automatic dedupe grouped ~120 alerts into 3 incidents, paging enabled for Sev2+

Mike B: seeing a bunch of identical 'kv-cache OOM' alerts from multiple hosts. pages are noisy, a lot of duplicates. i’m going to start a temporary routing change to send only one PD incident per cluster for now.
Liya Z: thanks. can we confirm customer impact before we mute anything? any 5xx% increase on the API?

Sam R: checking logs now — 502s up ~0.6% in last 10m, but 90th latency stable. mostly internal host restarts/reschedule during scale-up. customers not broadly impacted yet.

Mike B: ok, plan: 1) temp PD routing: set dedupe window to 10m for inference-runtime alerts 2) silence noisy host-level alerts with Alertmanager until probes complete 3) add a dashboard panel to track unique affected customers.

Nirav K: +1. can you paste the Alertmanager silence command? want to have it in thread for the handoff.

Mike B: doing it now.

Mike B: ```
# Alertmanager silence via API (temporary)
POST /api/v2/silences
{
  "matchers": [{ "name": "alertname", "value": "kv_cache_oom", "isRegex": false }],
  "startsAt": "2026-03-15T18:20:00Z",
  "endsAt": "2026-03-15T19:20:00Z",
  "createdBy": "mikeb_oncall",
  "comment": "temporary silence while we validate host restarts and adjust batching"
}
```

Liya Z: that looks good. also we should avoid total silence — maybe silence host-specific alerts but keep service-level severity metrics.

Mike B: done. silence created id: 8f3a2c. I also applied a PD routing override to route only the first alert in 10m per cluster to on-call_primary, rest to team-email.

PagerDuty Bot: PD route change recorded: rule-id=route-392, dedupe_window=10m, fallback=email-team-inference. Change by mikeb_oncall.

Sam R: creating a quick Graf panel now to show unique customer API keys that saw errors in last 30m. will attach link.

Sam R: Panel: https://grafana.company/r/d/X8h3XY/alert-noise-mitigation — shows distinct customer_count, 5xx_rate, and host_restart_count.

Oncall Bot: Note: mark that incident as 'noise-mitigated' if customer_count < 5 after 30m.

Liya Z: we should also create a short-term alert tuning PR: change kv_cache_oom -> only fire if error_rate_per_host > 5% OR affected_hosts > 3 within 2m. prevents single-host flaps paging everyone.

Mike B: agree. here's a patch for Prometheus rule:```
groups:
- name: inference-alerts
  rules:
  - alert: kv_cache_oom
    expr: increase(kv_cache_oom_total[2m]) > 0 and (
      (sum by (instance) (increase(kv_cache_oom_total[2m])) / sum by (instance) (increase(requests_total[2m])) > 0.05)
      or
      (count by (cluster) (increase(kv_cache_oom_total[2m])) > 3)
    )
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: "kv cache OOM (cluster-level)"
```

Nirav K: can we also add an Alertmanager dedupe/route rule keyed on cluster and alert fingerprint so we avoid cross-cluster duplication?

Mike B: yup, propose to add 'group_by: [cluster, alertname]' and a dedupe helper in the alertmanager config. will open PR.

Ops Runbooks: please add an entry to the oncall runbook: under 'Inference: OOM noise' -> steps we took: silence id, PD route override id, PR number, dashboard link, and criteria for un-silencing.

Liya Z: i'll own the runbook update and the PR review after you open it. tagging @Nirav for config review.

Mike B: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-alerts/pull/472 (title: "tune kv_cache_oom -> cluster-aware dedupe + thresholding")

PagerDuty Bot: Incident #PD-5209 created (auto). Current status: mitigated (noise-squelched).

Sam R: next steps for handoff: i'll leave the temporary silence until 19:20 UTC, but if after 30m customer_count stays < 5 we can mark incident resolved and un-silence. otherwise escalate to infra to look at host kernels.

Liya Z: for the follow-up work, owners: PR review (Liya), Alertmanager config (Nirav), dashboard persisted panel (Sam). I'll file tickets and link here.

Liya Z: Tickets: 
- INF-3417: Alertmanager group_by/dedupe rules
- INF-3418: Prometheus rule threshold change and unit tests
- INF-3419: Dashboard panel and alerting smoke test

Mike B: leaving a short checklist in thread for the handoff to evening oncall: 
- verify PR merged and deployed to alerting-dev (Liya)
- confirm PD routing persists (Nirav)
- monitor unique customer_count < 5 for 30m (Sam)
- remove silence after criteria met (Mike)

Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 2026-03-15T18:50:00Z to @evening-oncall.

Nirav K: quick question on metrics: can we tag kv_cache_oom with the model shard and quantization profile? that would help root cause. filing small telemetry task.

Liya Z: good idea. add to INF-3420: telemetry tagging for kv events.

Sam R: final note — if we see similar noisy patterns in the next 48h, we should consider a platform-level dedupe service that aggregates alerts and only pages after X distinct customers affected. long term work.

Mike B: agreed. will summarize post-incident and include unit economics (alerts suppressed, pages avoided) in the post-incident doc.

Oncall Bot: THREAD CLOSED (auto) — reason: temporary mitigation applied, follow-ups filed.
